HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a group, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). GROUP SHOT of five from a low three-quarter angle, a compass layout, the emperor high at the centre. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE FIVE PEOPLE in the frame. THE FOUR DRAGONS: THE SECOND EMPEROR'S FOUR GENERALS AS GUARDIANS OF THE FOUR CARDINAL DIRECTIONS. ALL FIVE ARE HUMAN MEN: the dragon names are nicknames, NOT animals, no beast heads, no fur faces; all five must be visible. Emperor Taizong stands high at the exact centre on a stepped dais that is invisible in the black; only his face, his crown and a few folds of his imperial yellow robe catch one thin overhead shaft of gold light; the rest of his robe falls into black. A proud predator's stare. Around him at the four compass points, each kneeling on one knee and facing outward like a guardian: NORTH (standing directly behind the emperor's shoulder, his face visible beside the emperor's, clearly a FIFTH figure, so the frame holds the emperor plus FOUR generals) the BLACK DRAGON, a lean scholar-minister with a long face and thin beard in black court robes, lit ONLY by a cold silver-grey rim along his face and shoulders; SOUTH (nearest the camera) the RED DRAGON, a Turkic prince with braided hair and a fur-trimmed cloak over steel lamellar, lit ONLY by a hard crimson rim; EAST (right) the BLUE DRAGON Li Shiji from the sheet, lit ONLY by a hard cobalt-blue rim; WEST (left) the WHITE DRAGON, a human Tiele steppe chieftain, broad-faced, a man with braided black hair and a white felt cloak, lit ONLY by a hard bone-white rim. ALMOST ENTIRELY ENCASED IN DARKNESS: every guardian is a BLACK SILHOUETTE with NO fill light at all; the only visible parts are a hard rim of light in his own colour along his helmet or hair, one cheekbone, the shoulder plates and the weapon, and his eyes. Those accent colours are the ONLY colour in the frame; everything else is black. Swords sheathed. Any sword is the ancient straight Korean ring-pommel dao: a small iron ring pommel, a short wrapped grip, a thin metal band and NO hand guard, a perfectly straight blade — never a katana, never a tsuba. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = THE SECOND EMPEROR; RIGHT of the sheet = BLUE DRAGON. THE SECOND EMPEROR — Look: Bearded Tang emperor: black futou cap with an upright pin, thick black beard and moustache, fierce scowl. Dress: Imperial yellow robe-cape over black brocade. Colour #c97a2e. | BLUE DRAGON Colour #4b78c9. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (deep manhwa tenebrism, darker than a normal splash page): about TWO-THIRDS OF THE FRAME IS PURE INK-BLACK. No set, no architecture or floor beyond what the scene names, no props beyond what the characters hold. Each figure is pulled out of the black by ONE hard, narrow key light from the side or from below in THAT PERSON'S OWN COLOUR, catching only a cheekbone, an eye, the bridge of the nose, the edge of a sleeve, a plate of armour or a hand; the rest of each figure falls off into solid black shadow and merges with the background, so neighbouring figures are separated only by their coloured edge light. SPLIT LIGHTING ON EVERY FIGURE: the lit side of each face and body in that person's colour, the other half PURE BLACK; no even front light, no fill light, no evenly lit robes — even white silk falls to black on its shadow side. Faces readable but half in shadow, eyes catching the light (ordinary eyes — no light streaks or glow across the eyes). At most a few thin wisps of smoke tinted by those coloured lights. Deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, hard cast shadows. Each person's colour is the colour of the light on them — never a glow aura, halo or outline glow. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show who they are to each other at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
